execution_requires: independent review, frozen exact argv/tool/runtime/input pins and separate root admission; existing finite supervisor only

cases.criterion: Compile the actual composed declaration/functions, with source-body SHA bindings, and call log_init. Assert magic/header offsets/reserved0/length0/text[0]0; non-header text seeded beforehand need not be erased. No reimplementation of logging algorithm.
Call actual log_str, log_hex and log_kv for zero,1,UINT64_MAX and mixed text. Compare every output byte against independently specified ASCII, including spaces and newline.

Append deterministic bytes across LOG_MAX-1,LOG_MAX and LOG_MAX+4096 calls. Independently calculate prefix; assert length saturates at0xff00, last in-object byte is NUL, and all further calls preserve the complete record. ASan/UBSan must actually run.

Set actual record length to LOG_MAX+1 and UINT32_MAX in isolated host fixture; actual log_char must make no writes, as confirmed by complete before/after bytes. This is synthetic fault injection, not a corruption recovery promise.

Saturate, reinitialize, append short text and decode actual length. Verify old tail is not exposed by the original decoder. Pointer/record lifetime ends with valid loader-owned storage; do not claim kernel or reset persistence.

Dump bytes of the actual C record, prefix a deliberately nonzero offset, then use exact pinned upstream read_log.py.extract. Require E1SXNU01, exactlength/text. Record magic-marker absence separately; do not mislabel local record as kernel checkpoints.

Compile actual loader_reserved_size. Compare safe cases against Python arbitrary-precision old reserve plus max(actual image extent), not copied C arithmetic. Cover inline/external/below-image payload, larger actual image, exact boundaries, end<image, payload-add overflow and image+size overflow; invalid cases preserve output sentinel.

Prove unchanged payload/boot_video/boot_args declarations and assertions, start.S, loader.ld, choose_window, cacheclean and accepted FDT/UI functions. Prove only loader.c and UI diagnostic literal change. This source check does not execute boot ABI.

Separately compile a genuine deliberate host OOB control using the same qualified ASan/UBSan runtime; require actual expected sanitizer failure and finite cleanup, retaining all stderr/exits. No success merely because a sanitizer flag exists.

Only after separate root budget: genuine AArch64 loader object/link using unchanged real upstream start/linker/dependencies; inspect actual .data.bootlog allocation/size/alignment and its extent before _payload_start, ordinary header size/payload placement and relocation reachability. No fake provider, SDK or device claim.

boundaries: No fixed physical mapping or MMIO on host or phone.
No framebuffer infrastructure rerun for a string-only UI change.
Host controls do not establish native image, writable image mappings, persistence, kernel checkpoints, Android restoration or phone safety.
